# The Cozy Canvas

> Cozy home decor ideas site — room-by-room product finds (bedroom, living room, vanity, desk, seasonal) with links to products on Amazon; sister project of The Cozy Canvas Pinterest.

## Pages

- [Home](https://pinteresto.vercel.app/): Cozy home decor ideas and product finds, organized by room.
- [Blog](https://pinteresto.vercel.app/blog): All decor guides and room-by-room product roundups.
- [Collections](https://pinteresto.vercel.app/collections): Product collections grouped by room and theme.
- [About](https://pinteresto.vercel.app/about): What The Cozy Canvas is and who it is for.

## Blog posts

- [Top Bedroom Products](https://pinteresto.vercel.app/blog/top-bedroom-products): Bedroom product finds — layered bedding, soft rugs, light-filtering curtains and warm lighting for a calmer bedroom.
- [Top Living Room Products](https://pinteresto.vercel.app/blog/top-living-room-products): Living room product finds — sink-in seating, rugs, warm wood pieces and lamplight for a room people gather in.
- [Top Vanity Products](https://pinteresto.vercel.app/blog/top-vanity-products): Vanity product finds — mirrors, good lighting and small organizers for a getting-ready corner.
- [Cozy Desk Setup Finds](https://pinteresto.vercel.app/blog/cozy-desk-setup-finds): Desk setup product finds — warm lighting, soft colour and tidy storage for a calm workspace corner.
- [Christmas Decor Finds](https://pinteresto.vercel.app/blog/christmas-decor-finds): Christmas decor finds — the tree, lights and soft seasonal layers, in the order the most-saved Christmas pins use them.

## Collections

- [Bedroom](https://pinteresto.vercel.app/collections/bedroom): Bedroom decor finds.
- [Living Room](https://pinteresto.vercel.app/collections/living-room): Living room decor finds.
- [Vanity](https://pinteresto.vercel.app/collections/vanity): Vanity and dressing-corner finds.
- [Cozy Desk](https://pinteresto.vercel.app/collections/cozy-desk): Desk setup finds.
- [Seasonal Decor](https://pinteresto.vercel.app/collections/seasonal-decor): Seasonal and holiday decor finds.

## Notes

- Pages carry an affiliate disclosure: as an Amazon Associate, the site earns from qualifying purchases made through its product links.
- Product picks are organized by room and scene.
